sources.title: Autonomous Probabilistic Coprocessing with Petaflips per Second
sources.snippet: In this paper we present a concrete design for a probabilistic (p-) computer based on a network of p-bits, robust classical entities fluctuating between -1 and +1, with probabilities that are controlled through an input constructed from the outputs of other p-bits.
